Design.evidence_source: [page/37/Text/9] You will first learn whether you are a participant B or a participant C after you have made your decision in all eight cases. You will also then learn (i) whether participant A exposes the situation, (ii) which situation is relevant, and (iii) which possibility participant A selects. Each of your eight decisions can thus determine your payment.
